title: Live review: trader-side per-package venue SL/TP snapshot so the due computation can evaluate the mechanics VENUE half (package vs venue mismatch)
note: [2026-10-26 session_01YbW2EEGjULBzDP2U1Hucxc] Split from LTR-1B-MARKET-TRIGGERS (manager ack 10:48Z: 'agreed it is Tier 2. File it as its own checklist row ... Do not build it in this lane'). FINDING: no stored venue read of resting SL/TP per package exists on the VM; /api/diag/live_review_due can only see the journal half (telemetry written, trade row absent). PROPOSED CHANGE: the exit loop already reads the venue position per symbol for protection (order_monitor._bybit_position_protection via bybit_position_book.select_position_row). Add an observe-only writer, beside position_path_history, that stores per order_package_id the venue stop/target it read on that pass (venue_sl, venue_tp, read_at, read_state measured|could_not_look) in a new column set or small table. The due computation then fires mechanics level 'venue_sl_diverges' when |venue_sl - package sl| > a registered tolerance (proposed 0.25 x ATR, register in config/live_trade_review.yaml first). Constraints: never raises into the exit loop, timed via tick_cost like position_telemetry, no new order path, could_not_look kept distinct. Tier 2 (src/runtime exit-loop writer): one operator OK before merge. Needs the new-table-wiring declaration if a table is added. [2026-10-26 lane session_01JA1tezUEqwFYzMVXkmouTK] BUILT, Tier-2 landing HOLD (manager merges). Tolerance 0.25 x ATR registered in config/live_trade_review.yaml FIRST (own commit). New table venue_protection_snapshot (PK order_package_id x account_id, latest read wins; DEVIATION from the row's per-package wording: a package on several accounts has several venue reads, one key would let one overwrite another). Writer src/runtime/venue_protection_snapshot.py is called by order_monitor._snapshot_venue_read from the three EXISTING broker sweeps with the prices they already read (no new venue call, no new order path); timed as tick_cost hook monitor.venue_snapshot; never raises. read_state is THREE-valued, not two: measured | none_resting (venue answered: flat/no stop leg; naked sweeps own it) | could_not_look (NULL prices, reason kept). Bybit/Alpaca coverage dicts gained additive target_prices/stop_prices. live_review_due.venue_events fires mechanics level venue_sl_diverges (once per package, deduped; cooldown-exempt like journal_trade_absent) when |venue_sl - order_packages.sl| > 0.25 x ATR (ATR = newest path-history bar else package entry ATR else could_not_look); stale (>60 min) or package-moved-since-read snapshots are could_not_look. not_evaluated now names mechanics_venue_tp (venue_tp stored, no TP tolerance registered). PROVEN on fixtures in tests/test_venue_protection_snapshot.py (GLD: pkg sl 414.54 vs venue 416.09; MGC: pkg sl 4270.03 vs venue 4040.8, ATRs ASSUMED) and on LIVE prices by scripts/ops/venue_snapshot_dry_read.py at 2026-10-26T18:45Z: 12 snapshot rows for the 8 open packages / 12 open trades, 11 measured + 1 none_resting, venue_sl_diverges fires for exactly one package (the real GLD wedge: venue 416.09 vs package 414.539, gap 1.551 > 0.25 x entry ATR 2.0925). OPEN: ib_paper MGC showed no resting legs on the diag view at 18:43Z (stale-view caveat) -> PI-20261026-VXKMOUTK-0002. CLOSING OBSERVATION (merged+deployed is not observed): after the manager merges and the trader restarts, the first VM sweep pass writes a snapshot row per open (package, account): scripts/ops/diag_fetch.sh 'venue_protection_snapshot' shows present=true and a row for every open trade, and scripts/ops/diag_fetch.sh 'live_review_due' shows venue_snapshot.packages_without_row == 0; alarm PI-20261026-VXKMOUTK-0001 (due_by 2026-10-30). [2026-10-26 20:55Z lane session_01JA1tezUEqwFYzMVXkmouTK] DONE: closing observation met. #20405 merged 51b2127a, DEPLOYED and OBSERVED by the manager at 20:53Z (git_sha_running 51b2127a1): /api/diag/venue_protection_snapshot present=true, 12 rows (11 measured, 1 none_resting, 0 could_not_look) for 8 open packages / 12 open trades; live_review_due.venue_snapshot packages_without_row=0, packages_unreadable=0; venue_sl_diverges fires for exactly GLD pkg-6a8e3fb325464be3 (alpaca_paper venue 416.09 vs package 414.539, gap 1.55125 > 0.25 x ATR 2.0925), the real wedge. ib_paper MGC pkg-011a7bf85ee54a6f reads none_resting = truly naked (owned by IB-MGC-NAKED-REARM, #20431). Re-read by this lane via diag_fetch.sh: every row has non-null ref_sl/read_at. NOTE: the manager's 'package_sl/observed_at render null' is a field-name mismatch, not a bug: the route returns ref_sl (package sl at read time) and read_at; there are no package_sl/observed_at columns. PI-20261026-VXKMOUTK-0001/0002 closed done.
